title: Chapter 272 Yu Lingqu'S Defeat
content:
Chapter 272 Yu Lingqu'S Defeat

Suddenly, the sound of a knife chanting on the stage suddenly broke out.

A sword light flashed by, and the figure of the young man holding the sword suddenly appeared in front of Yu Lingqu.

Buzz —

At this time, the holy book in Yu Lingqu's hand had already been suspended in front of him, emitting a dazzling light.

The broken knife in the sword-holding boy's hand slashed hard in front of Yu Lingqu, emitting ripples.

"Stop it, block it!"

Seeing this, everyone was immediately excited.

After the boy holding a knife came to challenge this time, no one in the academy could have survived three moves under this knife.

And now, after seeing Yu Lingqu, a master of the literary list, blocked the sword-holding boy, everyone immediately saw hope.

Now, there should be no accident.

But what everyone didn't know at this moment was that Yu Lingqu's face was extremely solemn on the competition stand.

Seeing the broken knife in front of him getting closer and closer to him, Yu Lingqu pondered for a moment, then clenched with one hand.

boom!

In an instant, the holy book in front of Yu Lingqu once again burst out with a powerful aura.

There was a loud bang.

A figure suddenly retreated from the competition platform.

"After finally, someone can fight."

The person who was knocked back was the boy with a knife.

But at this moment, the boy holding the knife was just slightly dirty in his clothes, looking at Yu Lingqu in the distance with interest.

"Damn, this kid is too arrogant!"

"Calm down, calm down, we are scholars."

"Reading? I'll read you!"

The people from the academy, whether from the Literature or the Martial Arts Academy, all pointed at the sword-holding boy on the stage and spit out the fragrance, and the spits flew around.

Yu Lingqu on the stage also looked a little ugly.

"You really don't show your full strength?"

Yu Lingqu's voice was low and he said with dissatisfaction.

Hearing this, the young man with the knife laughed and said, "I think so, but your academy is really not enough. I'm afraid that you will be killed instantly, and no one will come."

These words are extremely arrogant.

Even Yu Lingqu, who has been studying for many years, clenched his fists and trembled slightly.

"good!"

Yu Lingqu's eyes suddenly became sharp, and his breath began to rise continuously.

"I hope your strength is really as powerful as you said."

As he said that, the holy book in front of Yu Lingqu trembled again.

I saw countless dense runes flying out of the holy book and then heading towards Yu Lingqu.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Yu Lingqu's breath surged directly.

He climbed from the fourth level of the Immortal Lord Realm to the sixth level of the Immortal Lord Realm.

Don't underestimate these two small realms.

A genius like them, the strengths are very different between a small realm.

Seeing Yu Lingqu's breath so strong, the boy holding the knife in the distance also had a gaze.

The broken knife in his hand was also slightly tightened.

"Come on, let's see how you take my blow!"

Yu Lingqu shouted in a low voice.

The next moment, his body suddenly rushed towards the sword-holding boy in the distance.

When everyone below saw this scene, they were extremely nervous.

Can you win?

There is no way. Although this sword-holding boy is arrogant and deserves a beating, he is indeed very strong.

Even now, they are not sure whether Yu Lingqu can win.

But at this moment, a man suddenly spoke.

"Damn it, look at that guy!"

When everyone heard this, they looked at it.

"Hiss~"

The sound of gasping in the air sounded.

I saw that the young man holding the knife closed his eyes at this time.

"He's looking for death?!"

Everyone was unbelievable.

Brother Yu closed his eyes with all his strength, wasn’t that asking for death?

However, some people don't think so.

Xu Zijing is one of them.

At this moment, Xu Zijing looked solemn.

Close your eyes at this time, it doesn’t seem like seeking death, but rather holding your ultimate move.

But at this time, some subtle changes occurred on the stage.

I saw that the knife-holding boy's hand had a slight emitting a faint light from the gap in the cutter's knife.

The sword light appeared and seemed to be gradually completing the entire broken knife.

Seeing this, Xu Zijing praised him and closed the feather fan in his hand and whispered, "Brother Yu has lost."

When the people around him heard this, they all felt a little unbelievable.

"Brother Dong, what do you mean? No matter how you look at it, Senior Brother Yu will definitely win."

"Yes, yes, that guy was so scared. How could he lose?"

However, Xu Zijing shook his head slightly.

"You guys can see it for yourself."

At this moment, a sound of a knife suddenly sounded from the stage.

The next moment, a sword flashed.

The boy holding the knife instantly appeared on the other side of the competition stand, and then calmly closed the knife.

On the other side of the competition platform.

Yu Lingqu was already stunned.

After a moment, with a click, all the runes on their bodies were broken.

Yu Lingqu trembled and slowly touched his chest. Blood filled his body. Yu Lingqu laughed at himself and chuckled, "I lost."

In the end, under the unbelievable eyes of everyone, Yu Lingqu slowly walked down the competition platform and left here.

Looking at the back, it looks extremely vicissitudes.

Now, everyone stopped talking, just stared blankly at the young man holding the knife on the stage.

"Can't anyone in my dignified Heaven and Earth Academy really be able to deal with him?"

Everyone looked down and lowered their heads.

"Brother Dong, what should I do now? If you understand so much, you are giving advice!"

Several people were anxious to seek medical treatment and looked at Xu Zijing one after another.

Upon hearing this, Xu Zijing sighed, "What's the use of finding me? I don't like fighting. If you have this time, you can go to the top of the two lists, or go directly to the people on the monster list, then that's not the case. It's over."

On the list of monsters, it can no longer be described by people. Basically, everyone is a monster.

Without the strength of the Immortal Emperor Realm, it is impossible to enter the list of demons.

However, even if someone really finds an existence on the evil list, the other party probably won't take action.

Which monster will fight against someone who doesn't even have the late stage of the Immortal Saint Realm?

That was an insult to them.

More importantly, there are not only people from Tiandi Academy on the list of monsters.

The evil list is quite special, and as long as the conditions are met, you can be on the list.

Therefore, there are geniuses on the list of monsters in all parts of the fairyland.

I can only say that there are more people in Tiandi Academy.

When several people heard this, their faces looked ugly.

"But the academy is not without strength now."

At this time, Xu Zijing said mysteriously again.

"who?"

Xu Zijing smiled faintly and said, "I forgot the nine-clawed dragon that I just didn't have a long time ago. If that guy could come, there would be no problem."

"Nine-clawed Dragon?"

Several people looked at each other.

They also know a little about the Nine-Clawed Dragon.

Judging from the terrifying vision just now, you can also see the strength of the Nine-Clawed Dragon, which must be an extremely strong existence.

But now, they don't know anything about that dragon.

Even if the other party is from Tiandi Academy, I don’t know.

"Hey! What did you say?"

At this moment, a hand suddenly slapped Xu Zijing on the shoulder from behind.

This made Xu Zijing startled and quickly turned around to look.
